title: Menu
subtitle: Enter items by hand. Free plan: 1 language ({locale}).
subtitlePro: Edit your {locale} menu, review the draft, then publish when ready.
emptyCategories: No categories yet. Add a category, then items.
proToolsHint: Faster menu setup with review before anything is published.
voiceExample: Say in Vietnamese: “Phở bò giá năm mươi nghìn”. You still confirm before saving.
voiceListeningHint: Listening in Vietnamese… Say the dish name, then “giá” and the price.
voiceDraftReady: Name and price filled. Check both before saving.
voicePriceMissing: Name filled, but the price was not clear. Enter the price before saving.
voiceUnsupported: Voice entry is not supported in this browser. Try Chrome or enter the item manually.
voicePermissionDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in browser settings or enter the item manually.
voiceFailed: Voice recognition did not finish. Try again or enter the item manually.
moreProToolsHint: Voice entry is ready in the add-item form. Translation and photo enhancement are still being prepared.
importProHint: Upgrade to Pro to turn a menu photo or PDF into an editable draft. Nothing is published automatically.
importPrivacyHint: The selected file is sent to OpenAI once for recognition. Review every item and price before applying it to your draft.
importMonthlyLimitReached: You have used all menu imports for this month. The allowance resets next month.
importChooseFile: Take a photo or choose a PDF
importFileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 12 MB
importCanLeave: You can leave this page and come back later.
importFailed: Recognition did not finish. Your uploaded file is still available.
importServiceUnavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or contact support.
importRateLimited: The AI service is busy right now. Wait a minute, then try again.
importUnexpectedFailure: Try again. If it keeps failing, choose a clearer file or contact support.
importReviewHint: Uncheck anything you do not want. Low-confidence and missing prices need extra attention.
importLanguageWillChange: Detected {detected}, different from your current {base} menu. Because this menu is empty, applying the draft will set {detected} as its main language.
importLanguageMismatchExisting: This file is in {detected}, but your existing menu uses {base}. Importing another source language into an existing menu is not supported yet. Use a {base} file.
importLowConfidence: Low confidence — check this against the original menu.
importApply: Add selected items to menu draft
importApplied: The reviewed items were added to your menu draft. Publish separately when ready.
importReviewRequired: Every selected row needs a name and confirmed price.
importLoadFailed: Could not load the latest AI draft.
importUploadFailed: Could not upload this menu file.
importApplyFailed: Could not apply the reviewed draft.
importTooLarge: The file must be 12 MB or smaller.
importUnsupported: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
importInvalidFile: This file is empty or does not match its file type.
invalidOption: Name or extra price is invalid.
emptyGroupsHint: No groups yet. Example: Size (required), Topping (optional).
imageErrorUnsupportedType: Only JPEG / PNG / WebP are supported
emptyTitle: Your menu is waiting for its first item
emptyHint: Start with a category, then add the dishes guests can order. Publish only after the menu looks right.
emptyStepCategory: Create a category such as Drinks or Main dishes.
emptyStepItem: Add a dish name and price inside that category.
emptyStepPublish: Publish the menu when at least one item is available.
